items.summary: Recommendation: preserve containment-only execution and defer both CRO control-plane proposals. Evidence: 192 approved proposals lack execution, 47 failure follow-ups remain open, 28 improvements await measurement, and only 2 outcomes are proven (30-day scorecard, 2026-09-27). Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission, not site-attributable; ROI, margin, and causal lift remain unknown. Smallest next step: complete existing repair-or-close, measurement reconciliation, and legal/security evidence work before prototyping. Owner decision: authorize the prepared Woot permission request only after human-counsel review, or keep it unsent.

Handoff: retain the deduplicated execution-state-machine and read-only fleet-health cockpit as deferred CRO backlog. They are useful, reversible, and evidence-backed, but not queue-eligible while failure ownership, root cause, validation, rollback, deduplication, and measurement readiness remain incomplete.
